description: Saves a custom slice definition (filter only—no items). Items always live in entries. Use when built-in slices (api, domain, …) are not enough, e.g. filter kinds godot-scene + tag gameplay. Do not store duplicate entry text here. get-slice reads entries through this filter.

description.description: When an agent should use this slice

id.description: Custom slice id (avoid colliding with built-in: api, domain, persistence, …)

kinds.description: Include entries with any of these kind values

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

tags.description: Include entries having any of these tags

name: set-slice
title: Set Slice
